label: Versatile weapons tier list, Acts 2-3
note: Part 2 skips the tier-scale definition (given in part 1), so all 31 dumped '<letter> tier' passages are candidates. 20 are the first statement of a rating and become the item rows; the other 11 are in `unassigned` -- 9 immediate restatements or qualifiers of a rating already recorded, and 2 that are not ratings. The `act` field says which half of the video an item came from; `rated_in` is act2 for the file as a whole.

items.verdict: at-will bonus-action 2d10 fire AoE, no enhancement bonus; OBTAINABLE ONLY THROUGH AN EXPLOIT
+1 longsword with a Crown of Madness action; fun but situational, and low B at that
becomes +2 with 1d6 lightning ONLY IF BOUND by a pact-of-the-blade warlock or eldritch knight
a once-per-short-rest Ensnaring Strands plus a drow-only poison rider; both weak by Act 2
plain +1 warhammer with 1d4 psychic; the Blade of Oppressed Souls nearby is strictly better
generates heat stacks; only worth it for an off-meta heat-convergence AoE build
a generic +2 weapon; by this point far better options exist
+2 longsword that dazes on Smite hits, but the DC 13 save is unreliable
stuns on every crit via Hideous Laughter; needs clown face paint for immunity, great on GOO warlocks
+2 Charisma is worth the weapon slot by itself; the rest of it does nothing
best single-target throwing damage in the game, but ONLY AS A DWARF OR DISGUISED AS ONE
+2 warhammer with radiant damage and bonus damage to fiends and undead; strong for radiating orb
an Easter-egg reskin of a +1 longsword, found in Act 3
+3 trident with thunder AoE, mobility and spells; a contender for best weapon in the game
+3 warhammer that unstuns allies at will; defensive, so it costs you damage
+2 to saves against spells and bonus damage to shapeshifters; purely defensive in a weapon slot
+3 trident, at-will chilling strike; huge without Extra Attack; OBTAINABLE ONLY THROUGH AN EXPLOIT
applies wet on hit but not when thrown; niche and low-damage, called low B on balance
+7 damage on any crit, even with other weapons; wants a dual-wielding crit archer
still a fine archer's stat stick against githyanki, aberrations, fiends and elementals; much better acquired in Act 1
